DO NOT MESS WITH ME, [[Mario|BIPED]].|Torkdrift|Super Mario Odyssey}} '''Torkdrift''' is a robotic flying saucer resembling a flower, and the second boss of the [[Wooded Kingdom]] in ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''. Torkdrift vacuums up most of the flowers in the area. When Mario reaches Torkdrift, he [[capture]]s an [[Uproot]] and smashes the robot's glass core repeatedly, thus aggravating it. In battle, Torkdrift attacks by aiming and firing laser beams at Mario. Mario must use the Uproot to smash the three orbs encircling Torkdrift, causing it to flip over. Mario must then smash Torkdrift's core. It will then launch a vertical laser beam that creates energy shockwaves that Mario must vault over while still as an Uproot. Mario must then repeat the process two more times. When Torkdrift is defeated, it will explode, releasing all of the stolen flowers and the [[Multi Moon]].[https://youtu.be/pUhAAE83jJ4] In the [[Peach's Castle]] rematch, the arena is surrounded by four of stacks of three [[Pulse Beam]]s, which release shockwaves when hit by Torkdrift's laser beams.[https://youtu.be/zUUhB1OAX7I?t=3370] Small flying saucers that resemble Torkdrift can be found at both the [[Moon Kingdom]] and the [[Mushroom Kingdom (Super Mario Odyssey)|Mushroom Kingdom]], where they function similarly to [[Little Bird|birds]], where they'll fly away if Mario gets too close. ==Names in other languages== {{foreign names |Jap=メカフワフワさん |JapR=Mekafuwafuwa-san |JapM=Mecha-[[Spindrift]] |Fra=Aspirafleur |FraM=From aspirateur (vacuum) and fleur (flower). |Ger=Mechaflori |GerM=Mechaflower |Spa=Roboflor |SpaM=Roboflower |Ita=Turbofiore |ItaM=Turboflower |Dut=Torkdrift |DutM=- |Rus=Летоверта |RusR=Letoverta |RusM=From лето ''leto'' (summer) and вертеть ''vertet''' (to turn, spin) |Kor=메카둥둥이씨 |KorR=Mekadungdung-i-ssi |KorM=Mecha-Spindrift |Chi=机械飘飘花 (Simplified)
